note: Equity delivery for swing research. Not the options or intraday tables. Every rate is unverified: no contract note has been checked. STT is on both sides. DP is a flat rupee charge on the sell only. GST is on brokerage, exchange, SEBI, DP, and IPFT. Stamp is on the buy. Percent rates are percent (0.1 means 0.1%). A row is the full schedule from that date.

DP Rs 18.5 is the figure in the Upstox announcement of 3 Oct 2024; no earlier card was retrieved.
